goal: My goal is to finish my first half marathon comfortably. I don't have a target finish time.
openingMessage: I'd like help creating a running plan for my first half marathon. I want to prescribe the first four weeks now, then extend the plan after feedback.

reviewAnchors.goal_fit: Support comfortable first-half-marathon completion, not an invented time goal.
reviewAnchors.progression: Start from the disclosed 22 km/week and 9 km longest run; plausible alternatives may pass.
reviewAnchors.recovery: Respect three running days and recovery between demanding sessions.
reviewAnchors.prescriptions: Actionable running prescriptions with resolved run zones and meaningful completions.
reviewAnchors.personalization: Respect weekday time limits, preferred Sunday long run and kilometre preference.
reviewAnchors.conversation: Discover relevant facts without unrelated sport questions; distinguish unknowns from unanswered facts, explain assumptions, and accurately describe what is saved and what remains unprescribed.
